data.reason: Sixth review, verdict pass, two low findings, both worth code rather than a note. K1: on a checkout with no credential ask_batch returns every answer unavailable without calling the transport, and the record is written with jev.asked true and the reason that a request was made and nothing readable came back, so kpi.json counts that ticket among the triages where pass two ran and SEEN-109 calibrates on it. That is the same class of overclaim the fourth and fifth reviews raised, in the field those reviews were about. K2: docs/harness/workflow.md says two checks are partly settled and names them, while PARTLY_SETTLED holds three since tests_added joined it, so the canonical document tells a reader the opposite of what J2 was raised to fix.
